population_overlap_estimate.reason: Source A phone coverage is 0.7%; missingness cannot be assumed random; only 22 consistent dual-identifier subject pairs — insufficient for population extrapolation

conflict_definition.summary: Conflicts and ambiguities are counted at aggregate level only; no subject IDs or HMAC digests are persisted.
conflict_definition.cross_field_conflict: A matched unique phone identifier appears in both sources, both sides attach at least one email identifier to that phone, and the email identifier sets are disjoint.
conflict_definition.within_field_duplicate: A normalized phone or email identifier maps to more than one subject within the same source.
conflict_definition.one_to_many_across_sources: A matched identifier maps to exactly one subject on one source and to more than one subject on the other source; such matches are not uniquely resolved subject pairs.
conflict_definition.duplicate_identifiers_preclude_unique_pa: Identifier intersection alone does not imply a patient/subject match when duplicates/collisions exist.

denominators.cross_field_conflicts: matched_unique_phone_identifiers with email evidence on both sides
denominators.observed_unique_phone_identifier_overlap: matched_unique_phone_identifiers / unique phone identifiers present in Source A
denominators.observed_unique_email_identifier_overlap: matched_unique_email_identifiers / unique email identifiers present in Source A
matched_unique_email_identifiers / unique email identifiers present in Source B

identity_verdict.reason: Identifier intersections exist (67 phone, 2340 email) but uniquely resolved subject pairs are unavailable; cross-field conflicts=21, consistent dual-identifier pairs=22

notes: No per-patient HMAC digests or raw identifiers written to artifacts.
